params.prompt:
Photorealistic studio photograph of the exact same toddler boy shown in the reference images (image 1 is the original photo, image 2 is the approved straight-on front view of the same child). He is about three years old. Keep his identity exactly: the same face, very full rounded cheeks, small button nose, soft round chin, warm olive skin, brown eyes, the same round dark tortoiseshell glasses with clear lenses, the same dark brown hair slicked back on top with a clean skin fade around the sides and back, the same hairline, the same toddler head-to-body proportions. Same outfit: plain white crew-neck T-shirt, beige shorts with rolled hems, bare feet.

VIEW: pure side profile. His whole body and head are turned 90 degrees so that his nose points at the LEFT edge of the image and the camera sees only his own left side: one eye, the side of the glasses with the temple arm running to the ear, and his left ear, which has NO earring. In profile his cheek is still very full and round and bulges forward, with a small button nose, soft lips, a small soft chin and toddler fullness under the chin. Do not flatten the cheek, do not sharpen the nose or chin. The fade on the side of the head is clearly visible.

FULL BODY, the same scale and framing as reference image 2: the whole child from the top of his hair to his toes, centred, a little space above the head and below the feet, soft contact shadow under the feet. Relaxed standing pose, arms hanging slightly away from the torso, hands relaxed and open with five natural fingers, feet flat on the floor.

Warm ivory seamless studio background, soft even studio lighting. Camera at the child's eye level, level horizon, 85mm lens look, no wide-angle distortion. Neutral, gently curious, quietly confident expression, mouth closed. Natural skin texture and fabric texture, a real photograph. No props, no text, no logos, no labels, no watermark. Not a cartoon, no enlarged eyes, no plastic skin, no adult facial proportions.
